common_surface: Real configured core-only HTTP SYNC EXTERNAL, separate deterministic backend echoing input, no retries or keys
affinity: taskset -c 5-8; inherited by server, backend and generator; four Cortex-X925 cores

async.replay: Recent deep output is conservatively declined (404), and replay of its still-valid key returns 410 with no new attempt. Capacity eviction separately covered by fresh R2.
async.calibration: Prior 100/120-offer eviction probes are rejected and preserved. Caffeine did not deterministically evict a previously read flat result, and terminal keys expire ttl after completion, not maxLifetime+ttl. Common SYNC runs used the exact archived executed-common-harness, whose SYNC branch is unchanged.

latency: All successful samples, nearest-rank ceil(n*q), nanoseconds; report send-to-terminal-observation and intended-arrival-to-observation separately. ASYNC acknowledgement is separate. Terminal event timestamp is also retained.
allocation: JDK25 getTotalThreadAllocatedBytes process cumulative delta through cohort drain, including probe, retries/failures if any, divided by unique terminal successes. Validated 64MiB escaped platform and virtual allocations after thread exit. No heap delta substitution.
sampling: Every 1s plus snapshot response/Prometheus cost; coarse sampled peaks, independently read counters, not atomic maxima. Separate no-periodic-sampling auxiliary passes were not run under the authoring timebox; observer overhead is included and unquantified.
async_terminal_observer: Read-only bounded best-effort listener on existing ExecutionStore.onTerminal; keeps only execution identity/state/output id/timestamp, consumes each event on observation. Enabled only for B ASYNC; no payload/record retained. Required because R1 correctly declines deep/wide archive outcomes.
gc: Warm idle, drained, post-policy, removed. Existing cache size accessors perform maintenance before System.gc. Verify GC count increase, then measure used heap. All checkpoints outside latency/allocation windows. Class histograms use -all after verified GC and may include observer-created dead objects.
accounting: Fixed unique request IDs and execution IDs. Require offered=admitted=unique terminal successes for ordinary common surface. Refusals, transport failures, terminal errors and unresolved admissions are separate. Backend attempt IDs reconcile warm-up plus measured work. Never count replay as useful new work.
scope: Moderate-load latency/cost/retention control, not sustainable peak capacity or statistical equivalence. A contains known bugs and cannot be an acceptance control. P23 reruns frozen B versus C contemporaneously; investigate repeatable >5% useful throughput loss or p95/p99 increase.
limitations: Host has unrelated background services; affinity is not exclusive CPU reservation
Three repeats cannot establish statistical equivalence
Polling observer adds bounded ASYNC observation lag
Short profiles do not replace P24 soak
Unselected/external owners use explicit unavailable/not_applicable states
